title: 四层 Recap 机制
brief: A clean editorial technical infographic showing four stacked layers of a software system, on a subtle warm-off-white or dark paper background with restrained palette. From bottom to top (or back to front) as translucent stacked bands/cards: (1) Bottom layer labeled 'Compaction' with a subtle hard-drive/save icon and Chinese '上下文压缩 · 主模型+thinking' — representing context window compression; (2) Layer 2 labeled 'Prompt Recap' with a circular-arrow/loop icon and Chinese '自校正 Trick · Turn-end' — representing turn-end self-reminder; (3) Layer 3 labeled 'Away Summary' with a coffee-cup icon and Chinese 'Away Summary · Haiku 小模型' — representing away/background summary; (4) Top/foreground layer labeled 'End-of-Turn Recap' highlighted in warm clay-orange glow, with a terminal-cursor icon and Chinese 'End-of-Turn · StructuredOutput' — the user-visible recap line. Each layer has a short Chinese caption and small English tag. The layers visually stack/merge into a glowing terminal-cursor focal point at the top-right, where the text '* recap: Goal: ...' appears as the ultimate output. Style: soft-tech diagram, flat-with-depth, editorial magazine technical illustration, muted indigo/slate background, clay-orange accent only on the top layer. Thin dashed connector lines between layers. NOT a 3D render, NOT cyberpunk neon, NOT a corporate slide deck infographic. More like a refined Wired/RACONTEUR style technical illustration. Clean sans-serif typography. All Chinese and English text must be legible and correctly spelled.
